title: Faster Minecarts
body:
#  Faster Minecarts

This plugin makes minecarts significantly faster while keeping them stable and usable. Even at high speeds, minecarts automatically slow down near edges and slopes, so they stay on the track instead of flying off.

---

##  Features

> Faster travel without losing control.

- Increases minecart speed beyond vanilla limits  
- Smart slowing near edges, turns, and slopes  
- Global and per-minecart speed control  
- Simple commands and intuitive in-game interaction  

---

##  Global Speed

Control the speed of every minecart on the server.

> Command: `/setminecraftspeed <1-5>`

> Permission: `minecartspeed.set`

> Config support: Yes  

![Global Speed Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df311ce0599a977455e6cc4e240347e1ffc99cdb_0.webp)

Applies to all minecarts unless overridden by a custom speed setting.

---

##  Custom Speed

Fine-tune individual minecarts for different tracks or builds.

- Shift + Right Click (Minecart)  
- Sets a custom speed for that specific minecart  
- Overrides global speed settings  

Perfect for mixing normal routes with high-speed tracks.

![Custom Speed Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4dd00287bd0d4cb813fa6d4a034372074a68a1d0.png)
